**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.8.6

### What's new
- **Add your own launchers.** "Add game or launcher" → *New launcher*: give it a name, optionally the launcher program and a games folder (every subfolder becomes a game). It shows up in the sidebar with its games – covers, favourites and play time included, no friends list. Single games can be assigned to it as well.
- **Right-click menu in the sidebar.** Right-click a launcher to open, hide or (for your own launchers) remove it. Right-click an empty spot to see hidden launchers and show them again – the same setting as in Settings → Launchers.
- **Favourites belong to your Ludora account.** When you're signed in, your favourites are stored encrypted in your account and follow you to every device.
- **Link each launcher on its own.** The Ludora account window shows every launcher in its own row: **Sign in**, **Link**, or the reason why linking failed.
- **List view:** only the launcher logo next to each game (name on hover), so long names have more room.
- Removing a launcher now asks in a Ludora-styled window instead of a system dialog.

### Updating
Just click the update button as usual. Settings, sign-ins and covers stay.

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.8.6.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Ludora-0.8.6-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.8.6-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.8.6-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.8.6-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.

**Deutsch:** Eigene Launcher hinzufügen (Name, Programm und Spieleordner – jeder Unterordner wird ein Spiel), Rechtsklick-Menü in der Seitenleiste zum Öffnen, Ausblenden und Entfernen von Launchern (Rechtsklick auf eine freie Stelle blendet sie wieder ein), Favoriten hängen jetzt am Ludora-Konto und kommen auf alle Geräte mit, im Ludora-Konto lässt sich jeder Launcher einzeln anmelden und verknüpfen, und in der Listenansicht steht nur noch das Launcher-Logo. Update wie gewohnt über den Update-Knopf.
